name: first-principles
description: Derive auditable engineering decisions and harden repositories against production-grade quality bars.

interface.longDescription: Reframe engineering problems from current evidence and hard constraints, then review or harden repositories against applicable production-grade quality bars with executable validation, contract audits, scoped fixes, and observable acceptance evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $engineering to derive the smallest defensible change from current evidence and hard constraints.
